messages.subject: from pairs() to ggplot-scatterplot matrix
parts:
Hi,

I'd like to produce a scatterplot matrix where some of the axis should be log-scaled (and appropriately labeled) while others not.
Furthermore I'd like to show on one half of the matrix the dot plots (with a "trend" line) and on the other half the correlation factor r and its significane level.
So far I have done this plot with the function pairs() but I can't get it working to set log-scaled axis. Due to that and because all my other plot were made in ggplot I consider also to make this matrix-plot in ggplot. Does anyone has experience with scatterplot matrix plot including correlation results?

Here what I've done so far:

panel.cor <- function(x, y, digits=2, prefix="", cex.cor)
{
usr <- par("usr"); on.exit(par(usr))
par(usr = c(0, 1, 0, 1))
r <- abs(cor(x, y))
txt <- format(c(r, 0.123456789), digits=digits)[1]
txt <- paste(prefix, txt, sep="")
if(missing(cex.cor)) cex <- 0.5/strwidth(txt)

test <- cor.test(x,y)
# borrowed from printCoefmat
Signif <- symnum(test$p.value, corr = FALSE, na = FALSE,
cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 1),
symbols = c("***", "**", "*", ".", " "))

text(0.5, 0.5, paste(txt,Signif), cex = 2)
}

# Test with data
data(iris)
p1 <- pairs(iris[1:3], lower.panel = function(...) panel.smooth(..., col.smooth="grey"), upper.panel=panel.cor)

# most simpliest ggplot2 approach
p2 <- plotmatrix(iris[1:3])

/Johannes

Check out the code for the ezCor function from the ez package:

https://github.com/mike-lawrence/ez/blob/master/R/ezCor.R

You'll need to tweak things to apply the log-scaled axis while still
placing the labels & correlation values properly.

Hi,

this function looks really good for my purpose. There is
just a question that popped up: Is it already possible
to mix log-transformed and non-log transformed axis in a
faced_grid? This wasn't possible in the past afaik, so probably
the ezCor function can't be modified in that way I want it.
Anyway it would need days for me as beginner to understand
that code (especially as I am unfamiliar with layers) and to modify it.

So help is much appreciated. It'd be nice if one can specify the variables witch should be log_transformed in the function call...

cheers,
Johannes
